replay_card.canonical_content: The 1860 U.S. Census recorded 435,080 enslaved people in Alabama. This constituted approximately 45% of the state's total population. The published statewide totals also record approximately 526,271 white residents and 2,690 free Black residents.
replay_card.public_history_note: This replay card preserves only statewide census totals bound to AL_CIVILWAR_003. It contains no troop claims, battle claims, county distribution, or extrapolated ownership patterns. GENERAL_LEE remains a synthetic civic-history replay role only.

scope_exclusions: secondary estimates beyond published statewide census totals
